selection_data: All149 existing validation images; already used for checkpoint selection
primary_metric: Unweighted arithmetic mean of per-image PQ-like S=Q*F=sum(TP IoU)/(TP+0.5FP+0.5FN)
Q: Mean IoU over spatially matched true-positive instances; 0 when no valid pair, except empty-empty=1
matching: One-to-one maximum valid-edge cardinality, then maximum IoU sum; valid IoU>=0.5; scipy linear_sum_assignment
class: All annotated measurement_glass instances; no target-count truncation, dimension matching, or target-only subset
representation: Binary common768 COCO RLE masks; overlapping instance masks preserved, no partition/union before instance matching
candidates: Frozen native family selection, max100; RF top100 query/class pairs then foreground0 without NMS; CNN strict score>0.05 with native bbox NMS IoU0.5. No added NMS. Operating retention score>=threshold.
mask_rules: RF bilinear logits192->768 then >0; RTM native masks bool (sigmoid>0.5); Mask R-CNN native common768 soft probabilities>=0.5
selection: Maximize macro mean image PQ-like; ties within1e-12 choose lowest threshold. No secondary outcome selects threshold.
empty_rule: No GT and no predictions: Q=F=S=1 and exact-set/count=true. Only one set empty: S=0. Conditional matchedIoU=null if TP0. Negative images absent here; not validated on negatives.
secondary: image macro Q and F (their product is not primary)
plateau: All grid thresholds within absolute0.01 of maximum macro PQ; descriptive without changing selection
grouping: Existing proxy groups only, not confirmed buildings; show group-wise and equal-group PQ without selecting on them
test_rule: Freeze all9 validation-selected thresholds before reading TEST147 predictions/annotations for new metrics; no test sweep. Existing evaluated test, post-hoc protocol revision, not untouched test.
ap: Existing native ranked TEST147 AP unchanged because caches/candidate policy unchanged; no AP from operating-filtered predictions
coreml: Original-model CPU path only; equivalence to actual CoreML score/mask path NOT proven for all9. No threshold deployment or corrected physical accuracy claim.
physical_measurements: No27-capture errors or measurement availability used in threshold selection
runtime: Existing installed CPU float32 reference wrappers; no training, downloads, paid remote, environment installs, or GPU
public_sanitization: Selected methodological fields only. This public JSON has different bytes and a different SHA-256 from the linked private original.
